revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Checked proposals on the original. I don't see the my in line 11, so would suggest keeping it between brackets. Otherwise readings are good.

Vote - AcceptText - Readings: lin9 yes much better; lin11 yes, I wonder whether in fact one might argue for seeing traces of the My, so I suggest ἐ̣μ̣ο̣ῦ instead of ἐ̣[μ]ο̣ῦ; lin15 obviously correct. Fine. On finalization the text version under should be deleted and reprint in markup introduced.

Z. 9: π̣αρα̣[χωρή]σ̣ει → Σ̣αρα̣π̣[ί]ω̣ν̣ος (am Photo im Internet). Z. 11: οὖσα ὑ[π᾽ α]ὐτοῦ → ο̣ὖσα ἐ̣[μ]ο̣ῦ τοῦ (am Photo im Internet); vgl. P.Oxy. XXXIII 2677,10-11: οὖσά μου | τοῦ τινος ἰδιόγραφος; SB XX 14199,16: οὖσά μου τοῦ Ὠφε̣λᾶ τοῦ καὶ Βησᾷ ἰδιόγραφο̣ς̣. Z. 15: Λυκίο̣υ̣ (l. Λουκίου) → Λου̣κίο̣υ̣ (am Photo im Internet). Z. 17: Anpassung an BL XI 239. Ferner Hinzufügung der im Pap. vorhandenen Tremata in Z. 11 (ἰ(¨)διόγραφος) und 12 (ὑ(*)πὲρ).
